newsitem.title: CROATIA: Croatia, Slovenia to share Eutelsat satellite.
newsitem.headline: Croatia, Slovenia to share Eutelsat satellite.

text.p: Croatia and Slovenia signed a letter of understanding to share a Eutelsat satelite, the head of Croatian state radio and television (HRT) said on Wednesday.

"With this we will be able to broadcast programmes in a better way on all our three channels on the entire Croatian territory, as well as transmit across Europe," HRT chief Ivica Mudrinic told Reuters.
Mudrinic and his Slovene counterpart Janez Cadez signed the letter together with the Eutelsat director Jean Grenier in Slovenia's capital Ljubljana.

The two former Yugoslav republics will jointly use a single Eutelsat channel for television and radio broadcasting, Mudrinic said, but declined to reveal financial aspects of the agreement. -- Metka Jelenc, Zagreb Newsroom, 385-1-4557075
